scenes.say: Sunglasses for kids. Just a style thing? Let's check the myths.

scenes.en: Fact: a child's eye lets more UV light reach the back of the eye.
scenes.ta: உண்மை: குழந்தையின் கண்ணில் அதிக UV ஒளி உள்ளே செல்லும்
scenes.say: Myth: children don't need sunglasses. Fact: a child's eye lens is very clear, so more ultraviolet light reaches the back of the eye than in adults.

scenes.en: UV damage to the eyes adds up over a lifetime, starting in childhood.
scenes.ta: UV பாதிப்பு சிறு வயதிலிருந்தே சேர்ந்துகொண்டே வரும்
scenes.say: Did you know? Ultraviolet damage to the eyes adds up over a lifetime, and it starts in childhood. Over many years, it is linked to cataract.

scenes.en: Fact: UV passes through clouds and bounces off sand and water.
scenes.say: Myth: cloudy days are safe. Fact: ultraviolet light passes through clouds, and bounces off sand and water.

scenes.en: Wide hat + UV400 sunglasses. Play in shade from 10 am to 4 pm.
scenes.say: So, give your child a wide hat, and sunglasses with full ultraviolet protection. Play in the shade between ten and four, when the sun is strongest.

scenes.en: Dark lenses without a UV filter can let in more UV.
scenes.ta: UV பாதுகாப்பு இல்லாத பொம்மைக் கண்ணாடி வேண்டாம்
scenes.say: Avoid toy sunglasses. Dark lenses without a proper filter make the pupil open wider, and can let more ultraviolet in.

scenes.en: Book a kids' eye test this holiday.
scenes.say: And this holiday, book an eye test for your child too.
